run_visualize_policy_onscreen: run a MuJoCo environment policy visualization onscreen for a given number of episodes
run_visualize_policy_offscreen: run a MuJoCo environment policy visualization offscreen and save the rendered video to a file
run_random_policy_exploration: run a random policy exploration on a MuJoCo environment with no policy file provided
run_policy_evaluation_from_pickle: run a pickled policy file in evaluation mode on a MuJoCo environment
review_rand_policy_class: review the rand_policy class that samples random actions from the environment action space
